notes: Online play (casual matches, parties and friends) now needs you signed in to the store you got Blitzbreak from: Steam, Epic Games, Game Center or Google Play Games. Matches against bots and private games you host or join still work without one, and the menu says what to do when you're not signed in.
Everyone's store icon shows by their name: on name tags, the scoreboard, the lobby, your party and your friends list.
Getting ready for Steam and the Epic Games Store: those versions sign you in with your Steam or Epic account, and your name there is your name in the game.
A party searching for a game keeps searching when someone joins or leaves it.
